title: One line of an item's usage.jsonl
description: A usage entry: one step execution and the tokens it used (history.md, "Usage log"; F-137 D8). The item is the one whose directory holds the file. F-141 writes the entries and may add a field here.

at.description: When the step execution ended: an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC, in whole or fractional seconds, with a date that exists, a clock from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 and no leap second (`isUtcTimestamp` in `config/check.js`).

step.description: The box path of the step.

agent.description: The agent that ran it, for example `headless`.
